SELECT 
    acct_gate,
    CAST(REPLACE(session_telemetry->>'vpn_usage_pct', '%', '') AS numeric) / 100.0 as vpn_ratio,
    (session_telemetry->'ip_reputation')->>'proxy_hits'::int as proxy_hits,
    (session_telemetry->'ip_reputation')->>'country_count'::int as country_count,
    ROUND(
        (0.4 * CAST(REPLACE(session_telemetry->>'vpn_usage_pct', '%', '') AS numeric) / 100.0 
         + 0.3 * CAST((session_telemetry->'ip_reputation')->>'proxy_hits' AS numeric) / 10 
         + 0.3 * CAST((session_telemetry->'ip_reputation')->>'country_count' AS numeric) / 20)::numeric, 4
    ) as tei
FROM security_sessions
WHERE CAST(REPLACE(session_telemetry->>'vpn_usage_pct', '%', '') AS numeric) / 100.0 > 0.8
ORDER BY tei DESC;
